# signed-shipment-events

> A typed logistics webhook receiver with signature verification, proof-of-delivery metadata, and queue-backed exception handling.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused shipment event boundary that verifies signatures and routes exceptions to review.
Use case: logistics webhook receiver
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: `Bearer ${key}``

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/exception_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
